recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not duplicate the THO CodeSystem concept in core source; any remaining work should be THO/UTG release or package-version coordination.
issue_request: FHIR-37560 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requests adding `symptom` to the Observation Category ValueSet with display `Symptom` and the definition `A symptom is a manifestation of a disease apparent to and communicated by the patient.`
initial_application: No FHIR core source commit mentioning FHIR-37560 was found. The current core ValueSet source includes all codes from `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category`, and the active Observation.category binding points to that ValueSet.
additional_context: FHIR-34408 is the same Applied change family and also requested an updated `exam` definition. Later Applied issues FHIR-50889 and FHIR-52872 request the same symptom addition and are already represented on the combined branch. UP-717 was an earlier unresolved UTG request, while UP-738 is Proposal Implemented and updated the external THO/UTG source of truth for Observation Category codes.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because the requested code belongs in THO/UTG, and the current FHIR build already expands the core ValueSet from THO observation-category version 2.0.0 with `symptom` present.
